items.description: Copper pipe repair – fittings, pipe section, consumables
items.rationale: A fracture of a heating pipe inside the building is covered under 2.4.3(a). Materials and consumables are indemnified under 7.1.7(c) at a modest price for about 1 m of copper pipe plus fittings.

Trade labour is covered under 7.1.7(g) at customary rates. Roughly 12 technician hours plus a few helper hours, trimmed somewhat because the repair is small (Case 16 shows about €90/hr gross for an installer).
Insulation that formed part of the component before the loss is covered under 7.1.7(c). Quantity beyond the repaired 1 m section may be cut under 7.1.8(e), so I allow only a modest amount.
One travel/call-out charge per contractor is covered under 7.1.7(f); the price is calibrated to Case 16.
Disposal of the removed pipe and insulation is covered under 7.1.7(a) and 5.2.1. It is a small bag of debris, so the price is low.
General administrative or processing charges are not a repair cost under 7.1.8(b).

items.description: Tile cleaning, disinfection and coating 5 hrs
items.rationale: Cleaning and coating are directed at cleanliness and improvement under 7.1.8(a). No physical damage to the tiles is established under 7.1.5, and the line mixes in improvement work.
